name: v2-corexy-square
review: With CoreXY motor positions X+Y and X-Y, the four 20 mm square sides produce signed motor increments (+1600,+1600), (+1600,-1600), (-1600,-1600), (-1600,+1600), followed by (+3200,0) for the diagonal; final motor position is (3200,0,0). At 100 mm/s^2 and the source-defined 0.05 mm junction deviation, 90-degree and 135-degree turns yield about 3.474 and 1.761 mm/s. Continuous-profile durations are 0.86104, 0.82764, 0.82764, 0.84377 and 1.04839 s versus 0.86086, 0.82750, 0.82750, 0.84347 and 1.04692 s recorded, differing by at most 0.14%. Two simulator runs produced identical traces; discrete pulse timing and physical hardware remain unverified.
